description: Start building a school's academic policy index, in the background, unless a current index is held or a run is under way. Give unitid. The answer gives outcome: started, current (nothing started; the index is current for the publish served now) or running (nothing more started). A run takes seconds to a few minutes; read its progress with playlist_index_status. Writes the index into the playlist store; it saves no policy and calls no AI model.

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
